summary.name: Generated Photos
summary.one_liner: A web service offering AI-generated, copyright-free photos of human faces and full-body people, with a searchable gallery and tools to generate new images.
use_cases: find copyright-free headshots for design projects
generate unique photo-realistic faces for mockups
create full-body model images for marketing
anonymize a face by replacing it with a similar generated face
download image datasets for machine learning
integrate synthetic humans into a product via API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a gallery of AI-generated human photos that can be filtered to find specific faces. Users can generate photo-realistic faces or full-body humans by setting parameters in real time. Face Generator and Human Generator tools can also modify uploaded photos. An Anonymizer feature finds a similar face in the database by uploading a reference. For larger needs, it offers bulk download, datasets, and API integration.
notable: Copyright-free AI-generated faces and full-body humans
Parameter-based real-time face generation and filtering of gallery
Anonymizer tool that swaps a face for a similar generated one
Bulk download, datasets and API for large projects
caveats: Pricing terms are not stated on the page; custom work requires contacting the company
Specific photos or custom integration are handled by contacting sales rather than self-serve
